dict.string: Version 0.1.3 build 19 updates normal local-chat guidance to distinguish drafting code from executing it, excludes failed and duplicated current-turn context, fits history with the runtime tokenizer while preserving the current request and recorded results, and filters reasoning markers after answer prefaces while preserving Markdown code. Oversized context fails explicitly without replaying reads. This unfinished unsigned SideStore preview retains build 18 restore handling and data identity. Local regression tests do not establish general model quality or physical-device acceptance; native/model/device validation remains required. No broader autonomy, video downloading, vision or sync is added. Preserve existing app data and signing identity when updating.
Orivyn uses the microphone only when you start dictation or a voice conversation.
Orivyn transcribes your speech on this iPhone when you start dictation or voice conversation.
Only when you tap Get current location, Orivyn asks iOS for a one-time location displayed on this screen. It is not sent to a model or server.
Only when you connect to your chosen plugin server, Orivyn may access that server on your local network. Chats and files are not sent automatically.
Take a photo to attach and recognize its text on this iPhone.
